context: Decide policy before touching items: exempt more categories, grandfather items created before the lint landed, or sweep. Only then act. Do not mass drop+recreate items that have dependents.
description: The rung-falsifiability lint landed via todo-lint-rung-falsifiability-and-scope-completeness-2 (done). It is correct and valuable, but it was applied to a tracker that already held hundreds of items authored before the rule existed. Measured 2026-08-01: 'todo lint --all' reports 525 finding(s) across 277 item(s), of which 125 are specifically 'no falsifiability: every rung's expected text reads as passing on the unfixed tree'. No open item covers that backlog, so the lint reports a large standing failure that nobody owns and that therefore trains readers to ignore it. Verification ladders are create-time-only, so each fix is a drop+recreate that cascades through any dependents - which makes a blind sweep expensive and risky. Confirmed adjacent examples: findings-import-surfaces-undocumented trips it; cutover-record-corrections-and-quiescence-probe tripped it and was repaired by drop+recreate as -v2 (zero dependents, so cheap). The 'flake' category is already exempt, which suggests category-based exemption is the cheaper lever than mass recreation.

preserves.behavior: no item with dependents is dropped as part of a lint sweep without its dep edges being re-created
the falsifiability rule itself stays enforced for newly created items

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_db_freeze.py -q -n 0 -k "grandfather or falsifiab" && printf "grandfathering tests passed\\n"

verifications.description: Post-rule items still receive the falsifiability advisory

work_units.evidence: PR #1536 chose grandfathering by the UTC rule epoch. Category exemptions were rejected because legacy categories are free text across 57 values; mass recreation was rejected because terminal IDs and dependencies make it unsafe.
work_units.summary: Decide the policy - category exemption, grandfathering by creation date, or per-item recreation

work_units.evidence: PR #1536 commit 04df44c5f reports pre-rule ladders as countable grandfathered notes, keeps post-rule no-falsifiability advisories, supports an off switch for backlog audits, and includes UTC-boundary regression tests.
work_units.summary: Apply the chosen policy and drive the falsifiability finding count to zero
